tools.name: swell_list_products
tools.description: List products in the store, with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, search, field selection, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /products.

tools.name: swell_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by its record id or its slug. Supports `expand` and `fields`. Swell backend REST API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: swell_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories, with filtering, sorting, search, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /categories.

tools.name: swell_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, search, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /orders.

tools.name: swell_get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single order by its record id or its order number. Supports `expand` and `fields`. Swell backend REST API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: swell_list_customers
tools.description: List customers. In Swell, customers are the `accounts` model — this queries GET /accounts, with filtering, sorting, search, and expansion.

tools.name: swell_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer (Swell `accounts` model) by id. Supports `expand` and `fields`. Swell backend REST API: GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: swell_list_carts
tools.description: List shopping carts (including abandoned carts), with filtering, sorting, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /carts.

tools.name: swell_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, with filtering, sorting, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: swell_get_subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription by id. Supports `expand`. Swell backend REST API: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: swell_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (typically subscription invoices), with filtering, sorting, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: swell_list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons, with filtering and sorting. Swell backend REST API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: swell_create_product
tools.description: MUTATES LIVE STORE DATA. Create a new product in the store. Provide the common fields directly (name is required); anything else goes in `fields`, which is merged into the request body. Swell backend REST API: POST /products.

tools.name: swell_update_product
tools.description: MUTATES LIVE STORE DATA. Partially update an existing product by id. Provide the id plus a `fields` object of attributes to change. Swell backend REST API: PUT /products/{id}.

tools.name: swell_update_order
tools.description: MUTATES A LIVE ORDER. Partially update an existing order by id — e.g. change status, fulfillment, or notes. Provide the id plus a `fields` object of attributes to change, e.g. {"status":"complete"}. Swell backend REST API: PUT /orders/{id}.
